site_order: integer masks 0..7, least-significant bit h, next x, next y
finite_fiving: this round's finite model: d=5*h+r; F(d)=(d+5) mod 10; not F5 arithmetic and not the whole source fiving concept
double_stamp_labels: donor A5/B6/C7 with authored dwell; not count==5

status_meanings.NONE: named object being counted is empty: admitted successors, verified backing artifacts, or query outputs as stated on the Result
status_meanings.ONE: exactly one of the named object: usually a unique C2 output summary or unique verified table, not automatically a unique full law
status_meanings.MANY: more than one named object: Boolean C2 source laws, or other declared fibers
status_meanings.OPEN: admitted question whose remaining information does not yet determine a closed fiber
status_meanings.EXACT: the returned value is justified by admitted hot data or a verified backing/recipe
status_meanings.REOPEN_REQUIRED: operation is admitted but the hot summary is insufficient
status_meanings.UNRESOLVED: an expected backing path is missing
status_meanings.UNSUPPORTED: operation is outside the envelope contract
status_meanings.INVALID_DEPENDENCY: present backing bytes/frame/hash do not match the promised construction; this is not a proof that the mathematical candidate family is empty

not_claimed: equivalence of fiving splice and Double-Stamp restart
that this round's C10 fiving model is the whole source fiving concept
